confirmedSourceFindings.rule: MDC-026 retained data preserves last-success metadata
confirmedSourceFindings.mechanism: CarbonQueryLike/CarbonQueryState omit dataUpdatedAt; the adapter return drops existing query success time. CarbonSectionBody reconstructs deriveDataState from boolean data without a timestamp, so canonical updatedAt/ageMs become null. Source rows cannot identify the age of their retained payload. The page-level representative query freshness still exists and is not claimed missing.
confirmedSourceFindings.repro: Builtin Node passes a retained-data refresh failure with dataUpdatedAt=1000. Returned state hasData=true and refreshError present, but has neither dataUpdatedAt nor updatedAt. Actual output retained in command 3; deriveDataState's inspected timestamp guard therefore receives no last-success time.
